dialogue_turns.text: [very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, a dare] Tennis. One sentence.
[very low, close to the phone, almost a whisper, exact] Four thousand people keep quiet so two people can grunt.
[very low, almost a whisper, turning to him, doubtful] That can't be all of it.
[very low, almost a whisper, flat] There's also a man on a very tall chair.

payload.scene: A phone vlog from the back rows above a tennis court on a still, sunny day. Everybody is whispering; far off, a ball is hit.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy moment played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful, quick and sure of herself; to her everything is good news. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice. They answer each other fast.
